Subject: Post-demo recap + MAP draft (first pass)

Hi Elena — thanks again for taking the demo this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum toward your target launch: 

1) Attach: Redwood_MAP_Draft_v1.xlsx — first-pass mutual action plan with milestones, owners, and dependencies.
2) Target close: your team mentioned a late-December window; can you confirm the target contract signature cutoff that procurement needs? We want to align Redwood delivery milestones to that date.
3) Critical dependency: procurement needs PO issuance or signed SOW by signature cutoff — can you loop in Marcus (procurement) if we should coordinate paperwork?
4) Internal ask: Ben — can you own the technical readiness checklist? Marissa — can you lead pricing/contract redline coordination with Legal?

Proposed near-term milestones (from draft):
- Finalize SOW & pricing (Jordan / Marissa) — target 1 week
- Security/compliance review (Skyline) — target 1.5 weeks
- PO issuance (Skyline procurement) — target 3 weeks
- Contract signature / go/no-go (Both) — target by agreed cutoff

Please review the attached MAP and confirm the signature cutoff your procurement organization needs. If Dec 15 works for you, we’ll update owners and add a PO buffer in the MAP.

Thanks — Jordan

Jordan — thanks for the clear notes and draft MAP. Couple of items from my side: 

- Procurement asks that any contract be signed by Dec 15 to make the January budget window. If we miss Dec 15, approval will likely slip into Q1.
- For us to hit Dec 15 we need the final SOW and any material redlines by Dec 1 so our legal can turn it around.
- I’m CC’ing Marcus (external procurement consultant) who manages our PO process — Marcus, can you confirm the typical lead time once SOW is final?

If Redwood can compress the SOW cadence to get to a final SOW by Dec 1, Dec 15 signature looks feasible. Otherwise, we should set expectations to Jan.

Thanks — Elena

Thanks Elena — appreciate the clarity. Marcus — welcome, and thanks for jumping in. Based on Elena’s procurement cutoff (Dec 15) and the Dec 1 SOW redline deadline, we propose the following updated MAP cadence (attached): Redwood_MAP_Draft_v1.1.xlsx and SOW-summary.pdf. Key points: 

- SOW finalization deadline: Dec 1 (Marissa lead)
- Internal technical readiness (integration checklist): Dec 6 (Ben lead)
- PO issuance target: Dec 10 (Skyline procurement / Marcus) — we need PO on file or signed SOW by this date to allow time for internal approvals before Dec 15 signature cutoff
- Final signature: Dec 15 (all parties)

Risks and mitigation:
- If SOW redlines arrive after Dec 1, we’ll run an expedited 48-hour redline turn with a Thursday legal sync and possible price-hold for any late commercial changes.
- If procurement confirms PO lead time > 5 business days, Marcus please advise; we can add an earlier provisional invoice path.

Ben / Marissa — can you confirm you have capacity to hit Dec 1 / Dec 6 respectively? If yes I’ll lock these milestones in the MAP and send a version with owner responsibilities and acceptance criteria.

Best — Jordan

Attachments: Redwood_MAP_Draft_v1.1.xlsx (spreadsheet), SOW-summary.pdf (pdf)
